sql:
SELECT
  ps.cluster_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fp.listing_key) AS listings_mentioning
FROM fct_posting AS fp
JOIN posting_skills AS ps
  ON fp.posting_key = ps.posting_key
WHERE
  fp.is_open = TRUE AND fp.remote_us = TRUE AND fp.is_canonical_listing = TRUE
GROUP BY
  ps.cluster_label
ORDER BY
  listings_mentioning DESC;
